title: Ashbury Rewards Award Chart and Redemption Terms
content:
A Reward Night Rate night paid with Ashbury Rewards points costs the standard-room price of the award chart for the hotel's award category and the award season recorded on the reservation.

## Award chart — points per standard-room night

| Award category | Off-peak | Standard | Peak |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 5000 | 7500 | 10000 |
| 2 | 10000 | 12500 | 15000 |
| 3 | 15000 | 17500 | 20000 |
| 4 | 20000 | 25000 | 30000 |
| 5 | 30000 | 35000 | 40000 |
| 6 | 40000 | 45000 | 50000 |
| 7 | 50000 | 60000 | 70000 |
| 8 | 70000 | 85000 | 100000 |

## Redemption terms

1. **Order of payment.** Free Night Awards are applied to the earliest nights of a reservation and points pay the remaining nights, which are always consecutive.
2. **Fifth night.** When the member's tier has the fifth-night saving on points, every fifth points-paid night of the reservation is free, so a reservation with a given number of points nights is charged for that number less the whole number of times 5 goes into it. Each tier's fifth-night setting is that tier's figure.
3. **Deduction.** Points are deducted at booking as one award redemption transaction for the reservation.
4. **Account.** Points are redeemed only from a membership whose status is active and whose points balance covers the redemption; a suspended account can neither redeem nor receive redeposits until reinstated.
5. **Top-off.** A Free Night Award top-off is deducted as a separate certificate top-off transaction naming the award, for the amount the Free Night Awards terms set.
6. **Redeposits.** Points come back as a redeposit naming the redemption they return: in full on a cancellation recorded before the deadline, on a relocation, and when a change removes points nights.
7. **Changes.** When a change adds points nights or moves to a dearer season or category, the difference is redeemed as a further award redemption on the day of the change.
8. **Top-off redeposit.** Top-off points come back as a top-off redeposit when the award they topped off is released.
9. **Limit.** The points returned against a redemption never exceed the points it deducted.

## Retired clause

> **No longer in force.** The clause "on a cancellation recorded after the deadline or a no-show under the first-night points basis, everything except the price of the first night is returned when the first night was paid with points, and everything is returned when the first night was paid with a Free Night Award" is no longer in force. It is superseded by the current basis for returning points after a late cancellation or a no-show.

## Worked figure (hypothetical reservation)

A seven-night Reward Night Rate reservation at an award category 4 hotel in the standard season, for a member whose tier has the fifth-night saving, with one Free Night Award. The award covers the first night; the six remaining nights are points nights. 5 goes into 6 once, so 5 nights are charged at 25000 points: 125000 points, deducted at booking as one award redemption.

superseded_clauses: on a cancellation recorded after_deadline or a no-show under the first_night_points basis, everything except the price of the first night is returned when the first night was paid with points, and everything is returned when the first night was paid with a Free Night Award.
